newsitem.title: THAILAND: SocGen-Crosby to sign MOU with Asia Credit.
newsitem.headline: SocGen-Crosby to sign MOU with Asia Credit.

text.p: SocGen-Crosby Securities will sign a securities broking agreement with Asia Credit Plc in Paris on Tuesday, Asia Credit executives said.
"We are going to have a securities agreement with them," Asia Credit executive vice-president Pol Mahattanakul told Reuters.
"We have to split the securities and finance operations first and that is happening now. Some of our people are negotiating in Paris at the moment," he said.
The Thai authorities are encouraging finance and securities companies to split their equities and finance business.
Thai laws allow foreign firms to hold up to 49 percent stakes in Thai brokerage companies. It is unclear whether SocGen-Crosby will take a stake in Asia Credit's split securities business.
SocGen-Crosby sources declined to elaborate on details of the memorandum of understanding being signed later on Tuesday.
"There is MOU being signed and basically it will restructure Asia Credit's securities business," the executive said.
